title: Bluegrass Jam @ Chicago Beef Joint
event_description: Weekly bluegrass jam hosted by Brian Oberlin of Full Cord. Bring your guitar banjo fiddle or mandolin for an evening of traditional bluegrass music.
venue_address: 882 Ottawa Ave NW Grand Rapids MI 49503
event_venue_information:
Chicago Beef Joint

Chicago Beef Joint is a vibrant restaurant and live music venue located in Grand Rapids. While primarily known for its Chicago-style food the venue has become a hub for diverse musical events.

Weekly Music Events

The venue hosts regular events including bluegrass jams blues jams trivia nights and live concerts spanning multiple genres. Musicians can participate in open jams with backline equipment provided.

title: Open Mic @ Uncommon Ground
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring all genres of music. Voted Chicagos best open mic this Shure-sponsored event includes a competition with semi-finals and finals.
event_venue_information:
Uncommon Ground

Uncommon Ground in Lakeview is home to Chicagos longest-running open mic night spanning over 25 years. The venue has established itself as a premier destination for emerging artists.

The Open Mic Competition

The weekly open mic functions as a competition where performers can win prizes including Shure microphones studio time and cash. Winners from each week advance to semi-finals with final competition determining the seasons champion.

Music and Dining

The venue offers full dinner service starting at 4pm with tables available first-come first-served. Uncommon Ground also features an on-site brewery serving award-winning Greenstar organic beer.

title: Blues Jam @ Rosa's Lounge
event_description: Monthly blues jam session hosted by David Levit. Features house band performance followed by open jam session for all musicians. Backline provided.
backline: Full backline drums bass amps provided
event_venue_information:
Rosa's Lounge

Since 1984 Rosa's Lounge has been a cornerstone of the Chicago blues scene. This intimate 100-capacity venue in Logan Square has hosted legendary blues personalities and continues to nurture new talent.

The Blues Jam Tradition

Rosa's Blues Jam has featured iconic artists like Chico Chism Buddy Scott James Wheeler Melvin Taylor Sugar Blue Lil Ed and Mary Lane. The jam welcomes both seasoned recording artists and novices creating an environment focused on classic Blues songs and respecting the genres black creators.

Recent Developments

In 2025 Rosa's Lounge launched Rosa's Lounge Records an independent record label dedicated to spotlighting unrecorded Chicago talent. The venue continues to attract younger crowds while maintaining its authentic blues atmosphere.

title: Jazz Jam @ Andy's Jazz Club
event_description: Late night jazz jam session. The Last Minute Jam brings together professional local artists and up-and-comers to explore jazz standards.
event_venue_information:
Andy's Jazz Club

Andy's Jazz Club is one of Chicagos most well-known and respected jazz venues located just two blocks from The Magnificent Mile in downtown Chicago.

The Last Minute Jam

Every Wednesday at 10pm Andy's hosts The Last Minute Jam Session where musicians sign in at the piano to be called up to perform. The session features jazz standards and provides a platform for both established professionals and emerging artists.

Daily Jazz Programming

The venue showcases live jazz seven nights a week with multiple sets featuring local and touring musicians. Andy's maintains a commitment to presenting authentic jazz in an intimate setting.

title: Jazz Links Jam @ Jazz Showcase
event_description: Student-focused jazz jam session for ages 9-19. Students perform with professional mentors and house band. Free admission open to public.
backline: Full rhythm section piano drums bass provided
event_venue_information:
Jazz Showcase

Jazz Showcase is a legendary Chicago jazz venue with a rich history of presenting world-class jazz artists and nurturing young talent through educational programs.

Jazz Links Program

The Jazz Links Jam Sessions occur monthly from September through May providing a rare opportunity for student musicians to perform with professional mentors. Students fill out jam cards listing tunes they know and are called up to perform with the house band.

Professional Programming

Jazz Showcase continues to present top-tier professional jazz acts while maintaining its commitment to education and community engagement in the Chicago jazz scene.

title: Bluegrass Breakdown @ Judson Moore Distillery
event_description: Monthly bluegrass jam exploring traditional bluegrass and old-time music. Community-focused session bringing together musicians of all levels.
venue_address: 3057 N Rockwell St Building 5 Chicago IL 60618
event_venue_information:
Judson Moore Distillery

Judson Moore Distillery provides a unique venue for monthly bluegrass sessions in a welcoming distillery atmosphere.

Bluegrass Breakdown

Started in December 2023 the Bluegrass Breakdown brings together Chicagos bluegrass community for monthly sessions. The jam emphasizes community connection and provides opportunities for musicians to meet play together and explore classic and contemporary bluegrass repertoire.

title: Blues Jam @ Buddy Guy's Legends
event_description: Weekly blues jam hosted by Brother John or Jimmy Burns. Historic blues venue founded by Chicago blues legend Buddy Guy.
event_venue_information:
Buddy Guy's Legends

Buddy Guy's Legends is one of Chicagos most iconic blues venues founded by the legendary bluesman himself. Located in the South Loop the club has been a blues institution for decades.

Weekly Blues Jam

Every Wednesday the venue hosts an open blues jam allowing musicians to sit in with the house band. The jam maintains high musical standards while welcoming players of various skill levels.

Live Blues Seven Nights

The venue features live blues performances seven nights a week showcasing both established blues artists and emerging talent keeping Chicagos blues tradition alive.
